name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A switch that slides between on and off without a form submit. Instant preferences and feature flags.

discovery.name: Toggle
discovery.description: A switch that slides between on and off without a form submit. Instant preferences and feature flags.

configurables.how: Controlled: pass checked + onChange. Default uncontrolled depends on usage.
true when the setting is locked by plan. Default: false.
true by default for preferences; false if reduced-motion is required at the call site. Default: false.

gotchas.note: Provide a visible label (label prop or Field) — a bare switch fails WCAG name.
